# Public speech test recordings

Two human-recorded English clips from the LibriSpeech clean test split, acquired
through the public Hugging Face dataset viewer. Original corpus: Vassil Panayotov, with assistance from Daniel Povey, and the LibriSpeech contributors, [LibriSpeech / OpenSLR 12](https://www.openslr.org/12).
Dataset mirror: [openslr/librispeech_asr](https://huggingface.co/datasets/openslr/librispeech_asr).
License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

`manifest.json` records source IDs, original reference transcriptions, byte sizes
and SHA-256 hashes. The audio is not synthesized, and the reference text has not
been normalized or generated. These two clips are an English clean-speech
baseline, not coverage of noisy recordings, other languages, accents or your
application domain. No STT/TTS/S2S model has been run against them yet.
